user.title: National Geographic Photo of the Day
user.description:
Adds the **National Geographic Photo of the Day** to Home Assistant.

The integration checks the official National Geographic website once an hour and provides:

- **Camera**: today's photo, with title, description, photographer and source link as attributes. Show it on a dashboard with a Picture Entity card.
- **Sensors**: title, photographer, description, last update, image size, and API statistics.

No account or API key is needed. Click **Submit** to add it.

abort.already_configured: The National Geographic Photo of the Day is already set up.
